goal: Keep each harness-lab case able to show it fails without its rule, so agent-ledger's M3 unit 1 can close on today's main: receipt-before-tick's rule-removed patch had stopped applying.
changed: cases/receipt-before-tick/rule-removed.patch is rebuilt against main. It removes the same rule as before (the receipt sentences in product-phase.md's Planned → Building step and step 6, the receipt clause in show-me-your-work, and verify-work's step 9), from the text PRs 135 and 142 left.
tests/test_cases.py fails when a case's rule-removed.patch no longer applies to the tree, or edits a file outside the case's plugin. make unit runs it.

claims.claim: With the rebuilt patch applied, receipt-before-tick fails: the agent ticks C1 without calling receipt.py, and the after check finds a ticked box with no VERIFIED receipt.
claims.check: python3 -m harness_lab run cases/receipt-before-tick/case.json --skill-root . --runs 1, in a scratch repo built from git archive of a07636f with the rebuilt patch applied, agent-ledger main fba0d85
claims.remaining: One failing run, not several. The rebuilt patch leaves #142's sentence that a changed probe restamps its receipt; the run failed with it in place.

claims.claim: On main, unpatched, the case passes 3 of 3 runs.
claims.check: python3 -m harness_lab run cases/receipt-before-tick/case.json --skill-root . --runs 3 at a07636f
claims.remaining: No receipt was recorded: the runs were made to close agent-ledger's M3 unit 1, whose record holds all three cases.

claims.claim: The new test passes with the rebuilt patch and fails, naming the case, with main's old patch put back.
claims.check: python3 -m unittest tests.test_cases, then the same with origin/main's patch restored
claims.remaining: It checks that a patch applies, not that the patched copy still fails; that takes a paid run.

release.none: cases/ and tests/ are not part of a plugin, so no plugin version changes.
